mentions.name: WASI runtime for exaequOS
mentions.description: A WebAssembly WASI runtime for exaequOS, an operating system that fully runs in the web browser. It will support WASI 0.1 and 0.2, and a basic implementation can be tested by running 'wex' in the exaequOS terminal.
